name: Talking to Boop gets the reply that answers what you meant
case: The person chats to Boop on push-to-talk while nothing's working, one thing at a time: a hello, yes-or-no questions about Boop itself, praise, affection, an insult, bad news and tiredness, a joke, questions Boop can't know the answer to, nonsense, a goodbye, and a question about the agents. Each gets the reply that answers what they meant: a wave for hello and bye, a nod for yes, puffing up at praise, snuggling at love, a flinch at rudeness, leaning in at sad news, a giggle at a joke, a shrug at what it can't know, a head tilt at nonsense, and for the agents the facts on a sign, never a guessed yes or no.
why: ReactOutput's replies, each option saying what it's for and what it isn't; PERSONALITY: talked to, it always answers with a face and a reply, and its Examples give one for each kind of thing said
